title: Insperity Recognized as a 2025 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner
summary: Explore Insperity's latest news, awards, and resources
body_markdown:
*The annual list recognizes leading B2B companies with proven track records of supporting entrepreneurs and helping companies grow*


HOUSTON–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )–[Insperity, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2F&esheet=54357127&newsitemid=20251113890702&lan=en-US&anchor=Insperity%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=418ccd6b0787fa0f4be3b6b712711bde) (NYSE: NSP), a leading provider of human resources and business performance solutions, is proud to announce its fourth consecutive recognition on the[Inc. Power Partner Awards](https://www.inc.com/benjamin-butler/meet-the-2025-power-partners-in-hr-people-operations/91244465) . The prestigious list honors B2B organizations that have demonstrated success in empowering entrepreneurs and accelerating growth.


“Being named an Inc. Power Partner for the fourth year in a row reflects the trust our clients place in us to help them grow, scale and succeed,” said Paul Sarvadi, Insperity’s chairman and chief executive officer. “We continue to elevate what strategic HR partnership means to our clients—helping businesses strengthen operations, adapt with agility and invest in their people to drive sustained success.”


Companies on the Inc. Power Partner list received top marks from clients for being instrumental in helping leadership navigate the dynamic world of startups. These B2B partners support entrepreneurs across various facets of their business, including hiring, compliance, infrastructure development, cloud migration and fundraising, allowing business owners to focus on their core missions while driving measurable business growth.


“The entrepreneurial journey and community are core to Inc.’s mission, and it’s a true honor to celebrate this year’s Inc. Power Partners — the companies dedicated to helping small businesses and entrepreneurs,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “Whether they’re coordinating complex marketing campaigns or reliably supporting the day-to-day infrastructure of growing companies, these honorees aren’t simply B2B providers — they are true partners in helping businesses grow and succeed.”


For more information and to view the complete list of honorees, click[here](https://www.inc.com/benjamin-butler/meet-the-2025-power-partners-in-hr-people-operations/91244465) .


**About Insperity**


Since 1986, Insperity’s mission has been to help businesses succeed so communities prosper. Offering a suite of the most comprehensive, scalable HR solutions available in the marketplace, Insperity is defined by an unrivaled breadth and depth of services and level of care. Through an optimal blend of premium HR service and technology, Insperity delivers the administrative relief, reduced liabilities and better benefit solutions that businesses need to drive performance and growth. With 2024 revenues of $6.6 billion and more than 90 sales offices throughout the U.S., Insperity is currently making a difference in thousands of businesses and communities nationwide. For more information, visit[https://www.insperity.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com&esheet=54357127&newsitemid=20251113890702&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com&index=4&md5=40026ab7257626df1bb0c5354f9c65c2) .
